facts.label: Rotina com frequência
facts.sub: Use advérbios de frequência antes do verbo: I usually eat in the canteen. Com he/she/it, o verbo leva s: She eats rice.

facts.label: Frequência
facts.sub: Use always, usually, often, sometimes e never para dizer com que frequência. Eles vão antes do verbo: I usually eat in the canteen. Always é todo dia, never é nunca.

facts.label: Presente simples
facts.sub: Use o presente simples para hábitos. Com he, she e it, o verbo ganha s: She eats rice. Com I, you, we e they, o verbo não muda: We share fruit.

pages.title: A school canteen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is noon on a school day in Leeds. The bell rings and students walk out. The canteen is loud and warm. Ana puts her tray on a long table. Her classmate Opal sits next to her. They talk about lunch.
“Hi, Ana! Where do you usually eat lunch?” says Opal. “I usually eat in the school canteen.” says Ana. “What do you have?” says Opal.
